Type: tufted boxy accent armchair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, glam
Materials: woven upholstery fabric, piped edges, brass-finished metal hairpin sled legs
Colors: warm grey-green, soft gold
Shape: square boxy frame, flat track arms level with button-tufted back, loose seat cushion, thin angled metal sled legs, roomy but light on its legs
Feel: tailored, refined, airy
Goes with: brass accents, walnut, cream walls, sage tones; mid-century or modern glam living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Brooke Contemporary Mid-Century Modern Tufted Living Room Accent Chair, 35"W, Grey
product.description: Add mid-century charm to your home decor with this striking living-room chair. Its crisp lines and distinct shape combine for an attractive contemporary-style look, and its beautiful fabric upholstery will blend well with your existing interior-design style. Overall: 35"W x 35"D x 31"H; seat height: 19.29"H; seat depth: 22.83"D Solid-wood frame and fabric upholstery with brass legs Elegant contemporary-style design also pairs well with vintage or mid-century-modern home decor Simple assembly in less than 15 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
